declarations.name: Lemma A1. Comparing two connected factors
declarations.scope: In a minimal index-two full-cycle tree, if another connected 3-cycle C lies in a T-cut component V, then L_C>=N-|V|+1. If V is not uniquely largest this is at least L_T+2. A collective orbit maximum over all T factors, with k>=2, has a unique largest component containing every other T.

declarations.name: Lemma A2. DT pruning with other 3-cycles in the large component
declarations.scope: At that collective maximum, both smaller cut components are singletons. The DT Q^2/Q^-2 single-contact pruning, complementary full-cycle phase densities, equal smaller-tree synchronization, exclusive-leaf alignment and Q^2 strict descent remain valid with all other T factors in the largest component.

declarations.name: Theorem A3. Collective 3-cycle isolation
declarations.scope: Every X_{k,m}, k>=2, admits an isolated T with two exclusive leaves; deletion gives X_{k-1,m}. With the one-T base, T isolation holds exactly except (k,m)=(1,1); (1,0) deletes to the one-sheet empty tuple. No monodromy assumption.

declarations.name: Theorem A4. Connectivity for arbitrary mixtures containing a 3-cycle
declarations.scope: For all k>=1,m>=0,N=2(k+m)+1, every tuple with fixed full-cycle product and k 3-cycles/m DTs lies in one literal full braid orbit and one absolute orbit. T restoration at any old anchor and either orientation adds no attachment orbit. Proof is collective isolation plus induction from the one-T theorem.

declarations.name: Lemma A5. A five-move exchange of two 3-cycle markings
declarations.scope: Two T supports in this tree domain meet at most once. For a one-contact pair Q^5 fixes both literal permutations and swaps their strand marks. The adjacent loop fixes the complementary forest at every step. Gathering and undoing yields a loop on any separated such pair that fixes the whole endpoint tuple and swaps only its two marks; intermediate gathering can change outside edges.

declarations.name: Theorem A6. Fully marked connectivity
declarations.scope: For all k>=1,m>=0 and every fixed ordered type pattern, PB_r is transitive on literal fixed-full-cycle tuples. At a canonical tuple all Ts share anchor0 and Q^5 loops generate S_k; odd-order DT loops in W_m generate S_m. The literal stabilizer surjects S_k x S_m, cancelling the strand permutation of a full connecting braid.

declarations.name: Theorem A7. Removable factors and complete index-two exceptions
declarations.scope: Every positive-T mixture with m>=1 has a removable DT and arbitrary two-fresh-leaf distinct-anchor DT restoration reaches its unique component. Across all minimal index-two domains, pure DTs have no tuples at N3, one D5 orbit at N5, two A7 and two order168 orbits at N7, and one An orbit for odd N>=9. These pure rows acquire no extra pure-braid splitting. Pure5-to7 restoration retains the two genuine A7 attachment-distance classes.

declarations.name: Proposition A8. Monodromy, inner classes and spin
declarations.scope: Positive-T mixtures have A3 at N3 and An at every odd N>=5. Fixed-product inner and absolute quotients agree; ranging over both An classes of the long cycle with only even relabeling retains two product-class components. Standard DT lift signs are not canonical. In the pure-T corner canonical odd-order lifts have the single spin (-1)^(r choose 2), including infinity P^-1; no extra original-domain lifting split. Independently specified lifted branch elements are outside this classification.

declarations.name: Lemma A9. A higher-index dihedral family
declarations.scope: For every odd n>=5, A(x)=-x,B(x)=-x-1 give a minimal tree factorization of x+1 by two type2^((n-1)/2)1 factors, one literal B2 orbit of size n, and group D_(2n). Composite n admits residue blocks; n=1 mod4 is even. Thus higher-index proper monodromy persists in arbitrarily large degree, including primitive prime degree.

declarations.name: Lemma A10. A higher-index imprimitive family containing a 3-cycle
declarations.scope: For every odd b>=3, T=(0 b 2b) and B the three consecutive b-cycles on 3b labels have product the standard long cycle and total index3b-1, with expanded tree, but group C3 wr C_b of order3^b b. The b column blocks are nontrivial. A literal T no longer forces An after disconnected higher-index factors are allowed.

declarations.name: Lemma A11. A genuine lifting split outside the minimal tree domain
declarations.scope: Outside minimality, exactly125 literal factorizations of fixed P5 by three Ts split into full signed B3 orbits75 and50, with groups A5 and canonical spin +1,-1, respectively; absolute sizes15,10. Complete direct finite enumeration and exact Clifford arithmetic prove this finite assertion. It has genus1 and is rejected by the minimal-tree validator.
